name: 招待コードの公開範囲とリセット案内
prompt:
Recreate the Japanese invite privacy-and-reset panel from the native preview at exactly 390 × 170 px. Use the native preview for the exact layout and Japanese wording; use the original source crop to identify which line is a hyperlink and which is a separate reset action. Show a plain white component, no device frame, no extra card or controls.

Keep this exact three-line privacy explanation in Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E, centered at x=30,y=12,w=330,h=48:
このコードを共有すると、受け取った人が
グループに参加できます。招待したい相手に
だけ共有してください。

At x=30,y=82,w=330,h=16, center 「コードの共有について」 in Meiryo Bold 12 px and blue #1976D2. This is the actual hyperlink equivalent of the source's “Learn more about sharing WhatsApp QR code”; it must be blue, not green. Keep it clean and un-underlined. At x=30,y=126,w=330,h=24, center 「招待コードをリセット」 in Meiryo Regular 14 px #047857; this is the separate reset operation, not the hyperlink.

Keep the Japanese text exactly as written, with the same line breaks and vertical spacing. Only the hyperlink phrase 「コードの共有について」 is blue. Keep all body text gray and the reset operation green. Do not add a URL, icon, extra wording, border, background tint, button or decoration.
reviewNotes: The source learn-more hyperlink is blue (#1976D2 intent); only コードの共有について is blue. 招待コードをリセット remains green as an operation; body copy gray. Japanese text/line breaks match. Minor baseline and antialiasing residuals only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
